content.markdown: `resolveStyle` selects the render Style for a node; its existing structured signature is retained here. At the 0.3.3 baseline it honors an explicit `node.style_name`, then the deprecated runtime language-default mapping or `styles[0]`. Planned 0.3.4 adds conservative exact-filled-slot inference only for the implicit current fixed-arity path; see `spec.rv.automatic-style-selection-034` and the linked Remark. This Entry does not claim that change is implemented.
